market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil spike, Fed hike pressure, and AI safety narrative. Expect 3-5% volatility in equities. Energy and defense outperform; SaaS and EM underperform. Bond yields likely to rise further. Diesel at $6/gallon will feed into CPI, reinforcing hike expectations. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, risk-off bias.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle ($200B+ Google, Nvidia 2GW Australia) supports tech earnings through 2027. Energy transition accelerates with LNG expansion. Fed likely to hike 25-50bps then pause. Geopolitical normalization in Mideast would unlock EM. SaaS sector faces 12-18 month repricing as AI agents disrupt. Long-term: selective, quality-driven recovery.
